title: A library book was due back on my name 📚
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 1:12 in the morning my library app said a book on my name was due back tomorrow.

scenes.narration: At 1:12 in the morning my library app said a book on my name was due back tomorrow.
I have never borrowed a book in my life. The title was blank. Only a shelf number. Zero. Zero. Zero. And the due date was written in my own handwriting.
The branch was ten minutes away. The app said it was open all night. That was new.
Inside, the shelves ran further than the building should allow. A soft lamp glowed at the very end.
At the desk lay a card with my name on it. And a stamp. Borrowed, eleven years ago. Never returned.
I opened the book. Every page was a photograph. Me at my kitchen table. Me on the stairs. Me asleep. Years of nights, all watched.
The librarian never looked up. She slid the card across. Due tomorrow. And under my name, a second line, in the same ink. Item borrowed, you.
So tell me. Do you return it, or run?
